body:
Ship the release APK as package data in shoppinglist_server (like web_dist /
templates), served at a stable URL (/shoppinglist.apk) with graceful degradation
when absent. Link it from the web login page ("Get the Android app", shown only
if the APK responds) and from the invite landing page (server-side gated like the
T-44 redeem link). Ensure pyproject package-data includes it so `python -m build`
produces one wheel = API + web client + invite page + APK; document the deploy
story and the copy-APK-on-release step.
title: Serve the Android APK from the server; single deployable artifact (wheel) with everything in it
